name: 3000 psi concrete
description: Normal-weight concrete, f'c = 3000 psi at 28 days: footings, piers and slabs on grade. Ready-mix or bagged.
source: ACI 318-19 §19.2.2.1(b): Ec = 57,000·√f'c psi (via secondary sources; ACI 318 is paywalled). Plain normal-weight concrete about 145 pcf (ASCE 7 Table C3.1-2, via secondary sources).

name: 4000 psi concrete
description: Normal-weight concrete, f'c = 4000 psi at 28 days: slabs exposed to weather and freeze-thaw, and where a stronger mix is specified.
source: ACI 318-19 §19.2.2.1(b): Ec = 57,000·√f'c psi (via secondary sources; ACI 318 is paywalled). Plain normal-weight concrete about 145 pcf (ASCE 7 Table C3.1-2, via secondary sources).

name: Concrete block (CMU)
description: Hollow concrete masonry units laid in Type S mortar: foundation and garden walls. Strength is the assemblage f'm; grout and rebar the cores for anything structural.
source: TMS 602 Table 2 unit strength method: 2000 psi units in Type S mortar give f'm = 2000 psi; Em = 900·f'm (TMS 402 §4.2.2) (both via secondary sources). Density is per gross wall volume, hollow and ungrouted: a normal-weight 8x8x16 unit weighs about 34.3 lb (NCMA data reproduced in Norlite "Lightweight CMU" Table 1) over 7 5/8 × 7 5/8 × 15 5/8in ≈ 65 pcf.

name: Rebar, grade 60
description: Deformed reinforcing bar, ASTM A615 grade 60 (#3, #4, #5): footings, slab edges and grouted block.
source: ASTM A615/A615M Grade 60: fy = 60,000 psi. Es = 29,000,000 psi (ACI 318-19 §20.2.2.2, via secondary sources). Density 490 pcf from the nominal #4 weight, 0.668 lb/ft over 0.20 in² (ASTM A615 Table 1, as reproduced in Caltrans BDD 13-1).

name: Cardboard pier form (Sonotube)
description: Spiral-wound cardboard tube for casting round concrete piers (8, 10 or 12in diameter). A form, not structure: the pier itself is concrete.

name: Gravel base (3/4in crushed stone)
description: Compacted 3/4in crushed stone under slabs and footings for drainage.
source: Approximate: about 2,700 lb per cubic yard (≈100 pcf) loose, the usual supplier conversion for 3/4in crushed stone.
